raw.rationale: Immepip is a potent histamine H3/H4 receptor agonist with no known broad cytotoxic or lineage-selective anticancer activity at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration screens of similar GPCR agonists rarely show lineage-selective killing above base rates. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation for lineages where HRH3/HRH4 expression or histamine-pathway dependencies are reported.
